notes.title: Colorful background : Version 1.3
notes.notes:
[h1]New[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can customize the color of the background or import a 360-degree panoramas.
[*] You can set the color of the platform for play.
[/list]
[h1]Change[/h1]
[list]
[*] After import the picture of the jigsaw puzzle, the picture can be scaled between 0.5x and 8x.
[*] After import the picture of the jigsaw puzzle, the rotation and scaling of the picture is no longer centered on the picture itself, but on the pickup point. In Non-VR Mode, it rotates and scales around a fixed positive center.
[*] Each jigsaw puzzle can be scaled independently.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor improvements : Version 1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]New[/h1]
[list]
[*] The jigsaw puzzle can be scaled between 1 and 10 times.
[/list]
[h1]Change[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can move the platform directly by press and hold the down half part of the touchpad.
[*] After update the game ,when you import the picture from your computer , the resolution of resampled image is 3 times bigger than before.
[*] When you custom puzzle edge , the button used to change different direction of the edge is changed from touchpad to grip button.
[/list]
